Your phone feeling a little crowded?
Let Fast Clean give it a fresh start — smart, simple, and powered by AI to help you stay organized without the effort.

One-Tap Smart Cleaning
Fast Clean quickly finds things you might want to tidy up:
- Similar photos
- Random screenshots
- Space-hungry videos
- Duplicate contacts
Just tap once and clear the clutter — fast and easy.

AI Cleaning Suggestions
Fast Clean gives you simple, personalized suggestions like:
"Why is my iPhone storage full even though I deleted apps?"
"How do I make my iPhone battery last all day?"
"How do I manage app permissions for camera, mic, and location?"
No pressure, just helpful recommendations so you can manage your iPhone smarter.

Private Space
Have photos you prefer to keep separate?
Store them in Private Space so they stay organized and away from your main photo album.

Tools You’ll Actually Use
Fast Clean also comes with a small toolbox for daily tasks:
- Compress photos & videos to save extra space
- IP lookup
- Network speed test
- Charging animations
- Home screen widgets

Why People Like Fast Clean
It keeps your phone feeling lighter, cleaner, and easier to use.
No complicated steps, no stress — just quick tools that help your device feel refreshed.

Give your phone a little love.
Download Fast Clean and clean the smart way.
